title: Loïc & Marie-Gabrielle — La vie en famille avec Jésus-Christ
prompts: 16:9 cinematic family film, same recurring characters throughout: Loic, a kind older brother, and his younger sister Marie-Gabrielle, warm African-French family home. Morning living room, siblings sitting together, Loic gently explains in French that family is a gift where we learn to love, listen and help each other. Natural French dialogue, realistic lip sync, warm light, no subtitles.

Same Loic and Marie-Gabrielle, same clothes and home for continuity. They help set the family table together, smiling. Marie-Gabrielle says in French that helping at home makes everyone happier; Loic agrees that small acts of service show love. Natural sibling dialogue, cinematic realistic family film, no subtitles.

Same characters and continuity. Loic and Marie-Gabrielle talk on a sofa about disagreements. Loic says in French that a family is not perfect but we can forgive and ask forgiveness. Marie-Gabrielle answers that forgiveness brings peace. Gentle authentic dialogue, warm cinematic 16:9, no subtitles.

Same characters. Family atmosphere, Loic opens a Bible with Marie-Gabrielle. He says in French: Jésus nous apprend à nous aimer les uns les autres. She asks how they can live that every day. He answers: en étant patients, sincères et généreux. Reverent but natural, realistic lip sync, no subtitles.

Same Loic and Marie-Gabrielle. They walk together in a sunny neighborhood park, talking. Marie-Gabrielle says in French that praying together helps her feel close to Jesus and to her family. Loic replies that prayer gives strength in good days and difficult days. Cinematic, wholesome, no subtitles.

Same characters and clothes. Back at home, they comfort a family member with a small caring gesture, then talk together. Loic says in French that Jesus teaches us to notice when someone needs us. Marie-Gabrielle says love is also giving our time. Warm realistic family film, no subtitles.

Same characters at evening family dinner, joyful peaceful atmosphere. Marie-Gabrielle tells Loic in French that she is grateful to have a brother and a family. Loic says he is grateful too and that family grows stronger when everyone respects, encourages and protects one another. Cinematic 16:9, no subtitles.

Same Loic and Marie-Gabrielle at sunset near a window, family gathered softly in background. They conclude in French together: Avec Jésus au cœur de notre famille, choisissons l'amour, le pardon, l'entraide et la prière. They smile naturally and join family. Inspirational cinematic ending, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
